추가 확인(2020 보도): 삼성전자 평택 종합물류센터(CDC)는 2018년 완공됐고 TV·냉장고·에어컨 등 삼성전자 가전제품 대부분의 물류를 맡으며 자회사 삼성전자로지텍이 관리. 2025-12 다른 매체도 P6 예정 부지의 CDC 물류센터 철거 계획과 건축허가 확보를 보도. 포승 센터는 국내 생산 가전과 평택항으로 들어오는 해외 생산 제품을 전국으로 보내는 거점이 될 전망(2026-09 보도)

Further checks (press 2020): the Samsung Electronics Pyeongtaek integrated logistics centre (CDC) was completed in 2018, handles logistics for most Samsung home appliances such as TVs, refrigerators and air conditioners, and is managed by the subsidiary Samsung Electronics Logitech. In 2025-12 another outlet also reported the plan to demolish the CDC on the planned P6 site and that the permit had been obtained. The Poseung centre is expected to distribute appliances made in Korea and products made abroad arriving through Pyeongtaek port (press 2026-09)

. Company announcement (2021-07): selected as industrial gas supplier for the third fab at the Pyeongtaek campus, building a plant on a 100,000㎡ site in the Bangchuk-ri and Jije-dong area (urban planning facility implementation plan approved 2021-06-28). Press (2021): P3 gas suppliers are Air First and Linde, and Air First also has part of the P4 volume. Press (2026-05): the Pyeongtaek plant accounts for about 40% of the company's gas output, has about 729.6 kW of rooftop solar for its own use, and is building additional supply facilities in step with the campus expansion. The site box in this model (about 330 × 175 m) is smaller than the official site area because the construction zone to the west is excluded

. Company announcements: awarded the contract in 2015 for industrial bulk gases and a bulk specialty gas supply system for the new fab at Pyeongtaek; in 2018-01 announced that the second ultra-high-purity nitrogen plant was on stream and that two more nitrogen plants would be built

Company analysis report (2023): a specialist in piping and CCSS (central chemical supply systems) for semiconductor, display and industrial plants
